message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: Person (何某) signs a rental agreement with the actual car owner (郭某某) for a taxi, paying monthly rent. Then he lies to a victim (马某某), claiming he is the car owner, signs a rental agreement, collects rent and deposit (total 50,600). Later the real owner retrieves the car from the victim. Victim asks for rent and deposit back, defendant refuses. So this is fraud (contract fraud) i.e., "合同诈骗" (contract fraud) as seen in earlier examples. The examples: first case about contract fraud gave answer "合同诈骗". So likely answer is "合同诈骗". Also maybe "诈骗" alone? In examples, they used "合同诈骗" for similar scenario. So answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法占有" is part of fraud. No other crimes like theft, etc. So single crime.
